title: The Octocat's Origin
riddle: I live where code is born, in a file that every project starts with. Look for me where READMEs grow.
hints: Think about what you see first when visiting a repository
I'm hiding in the root of every great project
The file extension is .md

title: The Secret Workflow
riddle: I run in the shadows when code is pushed. Find me in the hidden folder where automation lives.
hints: I'm triggered by events like push and pull_request
My home starts with a dot
Look in .github/workflows

title: The Branching Path
riddle: I split timelines like a multiverse. Developers create me to work in parallel without fear.
hints: I'm created with 'git checkout -b'
I keep your work separate from main
Feature, bugfix, and hotfix are my common prefixes

title: The Guardian of Quality
riddle: I stand at the gate before code merges. If I turn red, the PR cannot pass. I check, I lint, I test.
hints: I'm a type of GitHub check
Branch protection rules require me to pass
CI/CD pipelines power me

title: The Ghost in the Graph
riddle: I appear as green squares on your profile. The more you commit, the darker I become. Streaks fear my absence.
hints: I visualize your yearly activity
I'm a grid of colored squares
Some people call me the 'contribution graph'

title: The Invisible Reviewer
riddle: I suggest changes without being assigned. I know every file you've touched. I'm your AI pair programmer.
hints: I was announced at GitHub Universe
I live in your editor and your CLI
My name starts with 'Co'

title: The Dependency Phantom
riddle: I alert you when your dependencies have known weaknesses. Ignore me at your peril — I guard the supply chain.
hints: I create automated pull requests to fix vulnerabilities
I scan package.json, Gemfile, requirements.txt and more
My name suggests I'm always watching

title: The Final Boss
riddle: I am the ultimate permission. With me, you can force push to main, delete the repo, or transfer ownership. I am the highest access level.
hints: I'm a repository permission role
I'm above 'maintain' in the hierarchy
Only organization owners can grant me
